title: dls.config.json
description: How a payload describes itself to the engine. Every path is relative to the directory holding this file, which is what the engine treats as the payload root. A payload that omits a key gets the default in scripts/lib/config.mjs, which is the 2one layout.

name.description: The design system's name, used in generated prose and reports.

packageName.description: npm package name consumers install, or null when the payload is not published.

repoUrl.description: Repository URL, used in generated install instructions.

identity.description: Path to an identity file carrying payload prose and provenance. Absent is valid.

paths.description: Where this payload keeps its files. The engine holds no knowledge of these locations.

tokenSources.description: The authored CSS the token build reads.

theme.description: The stylesheet defining light and dark theme variables.

components.description: The primitive component directory the rules govern.

ownComponents.description: Components authored by this payload rather than adapted.

barrel.description: The single export surface consumers import from.

schemas.description: Directory holding this payload's JSON schemas.

rules.description: The authored UX rule set. Optional: a payload with no authored rules still produces a valid derived graph.

integrations.description: Per-integration output paths. Open-ended: an integration the engine does not know about is still a valid key.

staleClaims.description: Phrases that were true once and are not any more, which the engine fails the build on. Optional: a payload without this file simply has no stale-claim guard.

rules.description: The opinions the engine enforces on this payload's behalf.

wordmark.description: The brand word that must never be set as type. Null disables the wordmark checks.

neutralRamp.description: Name of the ramp this system is founded on: the ramp every neutral surface is built from, and the ramp published in integrations. The canonical key.

primaryRamp.description: Deprecated alias of neutralRamp, resolved to the same value at load. Setting both to different values is refused. Prefer neutralRamp.

brandAccent.description: The single accent hue, as hex. Emphasis only, never a primary fill.

iconLibrary.description: The icon package consumers import, e.g. lucide-react.

iconLibraryLabel.description: Human name for that library, used in prose.

spacingBase.description: The spacing grid step in px. Off-grid values are reported.

grayscaleOnly.description: When true, any hue outside the declared ramps is a violation.

validationHues.description: Hues permitted for validation state and data trend, always paired with a non-colour cue.

signature.description: One sentence naming what makes this system visually identifiable.

ownComponentsInUi.description: Components that live in the primitive directory but are authored by this payload rather than adapted.

ownComponentNodeType.description: Graph node type given to those authored components.
